cases.question: When is Glastonbury Festival 2027?
cases.answer: Glastonbury Festival is scheduled for Wednesday 23 June 2027 to Sunday 27 June 2027 (5 days) at Worthy Farm, Pilton, Somerset, England. 2026 was a fallow year; the festival returns for 2027.
